title: I turned the age ratings into target practice.
author: Danos1981
selftext:
In this game, you roll a film reel off a camera and watch it bounce through U, PG, 12, 15 and 18 badges from old-skool film ratings. Clear every 18.

I made it on a platform called Spawn by talking with Savi their useful harness and agent for claude opus 5.5, the game engine is already integrated. The cinema themed setup and art and gameplay decisions were mine. the process was relatively painless with the help of a few mods made by other members on the platform.

From concept to publush took 6 hours. Since then, every game scene has gained a moving picture finale made of pegs: a flapping bat, toothed gears, a twister with more ideas to come.

Mobile focused/friendly

come and check it out at the link below and let me know what you all think, cheers!

  
[https://www.spawn.co/@wavebinder/pegi](https://www.spawn.co/@wavebinder/pegi)
